name: Awareness Programme on Child/Human Trafficking, Family Planning, Legal Awareness, Health etc.
benefit: - The benefit is to generate awareness among the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community on issues like child/human trafficking, family planning, legal awareness, and health (reduction of Maternal Mortality Rate, Infant Mortality Rate, Alcoholism, and maintenance of hygiene). - This awareness generation aims towards bringing effective social and behavioural change amongst the community.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a Non-Governmental Organization. - The applicant must have valid registration under Societies Act, XXI of 1860.
